title: How Many TVs Do Americans Have at Home
paragraphs: How many TVs do you have at home? A new report by the research company YouGov looked at how many TVs people in the US have.
The report was published in October 2026. It used answers from adults across the US that were collected between October 2025 and October 2026.

According to YouGov, 86% of American adults have at least one TV at home. The most common number is two TVs. About 25% of people have two TVs in their homes. Another 22% have one TV, and 19% have three. Some people have even more. About 11% have four TVs, 5% have five and 2% have six. Another 2% said that they have seven or more TVs. On the other hand, 14% of people do not have a TV at all.
People were also asked about their main TV. Half of them said their main TV is a smart TV, which can connect to the internet. However, 21% did not know what type of TV they had.

The report also looked at screen size. People who have more TVs are more likely to have a big main TV. For example, among people with only one TV, 19% have a main TV with a screen bigger than 50 inches. Among people with four or more TVs, the figure is 56%.
Other research has found a higher number. A 2026 report by Hub Entertainment Research found that 98% of US homes have at least one working TV. The two studies used different methods.
